description: Evaluate fixed starting capital scenarios instead of unlimited capital.
Each event consumes capital; no order may exceed available capital.
Stress the Phase268 fixed-notional proxy under smaller and equal notionals.
Cap simultaneous exposure; overlapping events must compete for capital.
Capital is not reusable until the event horizon exits.
Unused cash earns zero intraday return.
Only this capital-accounted formula may be called portfolio return.
Annualize only after fixed-capital event scheduling is materialized.
